name: Máncora
blurb: Mentions of Máncora have fallen well below their six-month baseline. Recent posts skew towards crowding and rising prices.

positive: Quieter than the better-known spots nearby
Good value compared with last year
Easy to get around without a car
negative: Some report crowding at peak times
Prices noticeably up on last season

quotes.text: Prices have crept up but it is still cheaper than the mainland.
The food alone would be worth the trip.
Second time here and it still feels underrated.
